ei.title: 함축 의미 추론 — 등반 성과와 자존감의 허구
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고3 모의고사
ei.lesson: 함축 의미 추론 — 등반 성과와 자존감의 허구

fullPassage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.

det.korean: ② concluding → conclude. 주어(You) + 동사 병렬구조 found ... and conclude. 동명사 불가.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 the boost is grounded in fiction이 이 글에서 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 외부 요인(비교, 환경)에 좌우된 성과로 얻은 자존감 상승 = 허상.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 성취감 지속: 반대(허구에 근거)

❌ ② 타인의 인정: 부분적(비교만 언급), 핵심 아님

✅ ③ 통제 불가능한 요인 → 자존감 상승 = 허상: 핵심 함축 ←정답

❌ ④ 허구적 목표: fiction = 목표가 아니라 자존감의 근거가 허구
det.tip: external factors(통제 불가) + grounded in fiction(허구 근거) = 허상에 불과한 자존감

ch: 등반을 통해 얻은 성취감은 오래 지속된다.
자기 가치의 상승은 타인의 인정에서 비롯된다.
통제 불가능한 요인에 의한 자존감 상승은 허상에 불과하다.
허구적 목표를 설정하면 등반 의욕이 높아진다.

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found <u>it</u> only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: You found it only slightly difficult → it = the climbing(등반 활동).
det.analysis:
❌ ① 파트너의 컨디션: 문장 주어는 You

❌ ② 자기 가치: 문맥 부적합

❌ ③ 외부 요인: 직접 지칭 아님

✅ ④ 등반 활동: found the climbing very difficult → found it slightly difficult. it = the climbing ←정답
det.tip: 앞 문장 found the climbing very difficult → it = the climbing

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 his가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: your partner was at the top of his game → his = partner(등반 파트너).
det.analysis:
